description: This is a Perl test script for the lighttpd web server, specifically testing HTTP request handling, response parsing, and server behavior with various HTTP methods, headers, and configurations.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A class providing an interface for testing the lighttpd server, including starting/stopping server processes and handling HTTP requests.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of LightyTest, initializing configurations.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the lighttpd server process with the configured parameters.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Simulates sending an HTTP request and receiving a response from the server, returning status.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if the server or environment has a specific feature enabled, e.g., zlib support.
